eyes: Your love deepens slowly, without rushing. Once you give your heart, it stays.
You don't rush, so a chance may seem to slip away—but you catch it at the right moment.
You watch things through before deciding. Work that calls for a big-picture view suits you.
Good people gather around you gradually. Your relationships grow in depth, not just in number.
When you fall for someone, your eyes give you away. Your love is honest and direct.
You spot opportunities quickly. With little hesitation, you're often the first to act.
A clear goal brings out your strength. Once you know the direction, you move straight toward it.
Your honesty earns trust. Just soften your words when your directness feels a little sharp.
You open hearts through laughter. People are drawn to how much fun you are to be around.
A casual gathering or an unexpected meeting can open a door for you.
Wit and fresh ideas help you find a way forward. You're good at changing the mood.
Good company comes naturally to you. You seem to make friends wherever you go.
brow: Yours is a gentle love with little friction. You build a bond where you look after each other.
The goodwill around you brings opportunities through recommendations and introductions.
Coordination and teamwork are your strengths. You help resolve tensions and move the team forward.
You get along with people at every level. Supportive relationships build up quietly around you.
You welcome love with an open mind. Your relationships move forward with room to breathe.
In this reading, your early path looks bright, with helpful people and open doors along the way.
You think and learn quickly. Even in a new field, you find your footing soon.
Your open mind helps you connect with all kinds of people, including those who lend a helping hand.
You know what you want, and your love is clear too. You don't leave a relationship undefined for long.
You make your own openings. You're more likely to act than to wait.
You have strong drive. Once you set a goal, you keep pushing toward it.
You form deep bonds with people who share your outlook, while keeping some distance when your values differ.
smile: There is warmth in your words. People feel safe enough to open their hearts to you.
A kind word can come back as an opportunity. Conversation opens doors for you.
You put people at ease, which helps you shine in collaboration and supportive conversations.
Many people find comfort in you. Good, lasting connections gather close by.
Your smile is part of your charm. Love often begins with someone being drawn to it.
Traditionally, this smile symbolizes good fortune through people, so opportunities arrive through connections.
You have a way with words. Communication and persuasion are your strengths.
When you smile, the mood around you changes. People naturally come closer.
You may show little, but your feelings run deep. Once you commit, you stay true.
You choose carefully, just as you choose your words. Once you take an opportunity, you hold on to it.
Your discretion and care suit work that people need to entrust to someone reliable.
A few trusted people matter more than a wide circle. Those few can stay for a lifetime.
aura: Being with you feels like a place to rest. Your love has a warm, steady quality.
Your easygoing presence encourages people to approach, and opportunities follow.
You help others relax. Work that involves care or coordination suits you.
Even new acquaintances soon open up to you. Yours are connections that bring hearts together.
Sparks catch quickly in your love life. Being together makes the relationship feel alive.
The more you move, the more chances you find. Doors open when you step forward.
You're not afraid of change. New projects and challenges bring out your energy.
People are drawn to your vitality. Your circle can grow quickly.
You don't open up easily, but when you do, it goes deep. Your appeal grows as someone gets to know you.
You wait for the right time without rushing. You act precisely when it matters.
You thrive when you can explore something deeply. The more expertise you gain, the more you shine.
You may seem distant at first, but trust grows with familiarity. Many people stay by your side for a long time.
nose: Your love is honest and steady. When stubbornness takes over, try giving a little ground.
This reading suggests opportunities that build steadily, with accumulation stronger than a single big break.
You have clear principles and persistence. You see your responsibilities through.
Your honesty earns trust. Relationships last with people whose principles are close to yours.
You bring flexibility to love. You adjust to each other without unnecessary friction.
Opportunities tend to arrive naturally through connections, rather than in a sudden rush.
You adapt well. Work with changing circumstances plays to your strengths.
You avoid needless clashes, keeping relationships smooth. Introductions often lead to new connections.
Your love is generous and warm. The person receiving it feels cared for.
A rounded tip traditionally symbolizes gathering good fortune. What you give can return as opportunity.
Your willingness to share brings people along with you. You succeed by earning their support.
This is a reading of being rich in people. There is rarely a shortage of company beside you.
jaw: You love deeply and make room for others. Your affection grows warmer with time.
You need not rush. Steadier opportunities come as time goes by.
You find your place in work and organizations where people stay together for the long term.
This reading pictures people staying close in later life, with bonds that feel like family.
You take responsibility in love. Once you form a bond, you stay committed.
Your staying power helps you make the most of opportunities that arrive later.
Your footing grows firmer with age. You're someone who keeps going to the end.
You're someone others can lean on. You remain a dependable presence in their lives.
Your sensitivity draws you to someone who shares your tastes. Love feels right when your inner rhythms match.
You read the room quickly and notice opportunities in its shifting mood.
You have a keen eye and care about detail. Work that calls for good taste lets you shine.
Reading the mood helps you keep relationships comfortable. Take breaks so that sensitivity doesn't wear you out.

온: Your love feels like a warm refuge. People feel safe with you and lean closer first. Just don't always be the one adjusting—put your own feelings into words too.
People bring opportunities your way. Introductions, recommendations, and unexpected meetings open doors. In this reading, good fortune grows through connection.
You shine when coordinating and bringing people together. Your team can work comfortably around you. Just don't take on everyone else's share.
This reading is rich in supportive connections. People are a kind of wealth for you, and that companionship stays reassuring even later in life.
강: Once your heart is set, you go straight toward love. You're honest and steady. When you feel stubborn, take just one step back.
You make your own path instead of waiting. You spot openings quickly and act first. The more you move, the more chances appear.
A clear goal brings out your strength. With drive and persistence, you see work through. This reading points to the power to achieve something substantial.
You form deep bonds with people who share your direction. Your words can be direct, so softening their edges helps those bonds last.
심: You don't open up easily, but when you do, it goes deep. Your charm grows with familiarity. Sometimes, let your feelings show first.
You wait without rushing, then act at just the right moment. Once you take an opportunity, you hold on to it.
You thrive when digging deeply into a subject. As your expertise grows, you shine and become someone people trust with important work.
A few trusted people matter more than a wide circle. Those few can stand beside you for a lifetime.
mixed: Your love has two kinds of charm. There is always another side for your partner to discover.
You can judge when to wait and when to act. You see opportunities from more than one angle.
Two kinds of talent support each other. You have strengths that can serve many different roles.
Different people connect with different sides of you. A wide variety of bonds can find their way to you.
balanced: You bring warmth, conviction, and depth to love. Yours is a love with staying power.
You know when to act and when to wait. Few opportunities slip past unnoticed.
You can drive things forward, coordinate, and explore deeply. You find your center wherever you work.
You balance close relationships with wider connections. Precious bonds stay with you for a long time.

eyes: Your gaze is like a lake—steady and deep. In this reading, it belongs to someone who watches carefully and moves at just the right moment.
Your gaze is wonderfully clear. It suggests someone who looks straight toward a goal without hesitation, whose eyes reveal what is in their heart.
There's a playful spark in your eyes. Laughter follows people with a gaze like this. You ease the mood, and good company gathers naturally.
brow: Your forehead has a soft, gentle outline. Traditionally, it suggests a kind nature, getting along with people at every level and easing conflict.
Your forehead feels open and spacious. In traditional readings, it suggests a bright early path, quick thinking, and encounters with helpful people.
Your forehead has a distinct outline. It suggests clear intentions and strong drive—someone who finds a way once their mind is made up.
smile: Your mouth has a gentle look. There is warmth in your words, and many people find comfort in you.
The corners of your mouth seem lightly lifted. Traditionally, that symbolizes good fortune through people. Your smile changes the mood, and your words help work things out.
Your mouth has a composed, reserved look. You may speak sparingly, but your words carry weight. This reading suggests care and discretion.
aura: People feel at ease beside you. You have a presence that lets them rest, and even new acquaintances soon open up.
Your energy feels alive. You bring vitality wherever you go, with the courage to welcome change and explore a new path.
You don't reveal your inner world easily. At first you may feel distant, but depth appears with familiarity. Once you open up, your trust lasts.
nose: In traditional face reading, the nose represents wealth and pride. A straight nose suggests clear principles, honesty, and persistence, with resources building steadily. Just watch that stubborn streak.
Your nose has a gentle curve. Traditionally, it suggests flexibility and smooth relationships. Resources arrive naturally through connections rather than all at once.
A rounded nose tip is said to gather good fortune. It suggests generosity and a willingness to share, making you rich in people as much as in possessions.
jaw: Your jawline is rounded. Traditionally, it suggests deep affection and generosity, with people staying beside you in later life.
Your lower face has a defined outline. It suggests responsibility and staying power, with a footing that grows firmer as you get older.
Your jawline is tapered. It suggests a delicate sense of taste and sensitivity, quick awareness of the mood, and a clear eye for what you like.

generalSummaries.온: Warmth is the center of your reading. People gather around you, and you make a place feel comfortable. Traditionally, resources also come through people. Just don't keep putting your own needs last while caring for everyone else.
generalSummaries.강: Drive is the center of your reading. Once you choose a direction, you open a path without hesitation. Strong energy can also bring friction, so take a step back when stubbornness takes over.
generalSummaries.심: Depth is the center of your reading. You hold things close without rushing, then act at the right time. The bonds you form tend to last. Still, if you reveal too little, people may feel distant—open up first now and then.
generalSummaries.mixed: This reading cannot be pinned to just one quality. Two sides support each other. That is part of your charm, and it gives your strengths many uses.
generalSummaries.balanced: You carry warmth, strength, and depth together. You know how to bring out a different side when the situation calls for it. That is a rare kind of balance.
